phone_adapter.classification: Explicit standards-based integration choice, not recovered phone profile or validated HNCS equivalence
phone_adapter.input: White-balanced linear sRGB D65 from a documented decoder; no further Hasselblad sensor matrix or WB
phone_adapter.method: sRGB->XYZ, Bradford adaptation from sRGB matrix white to recovered native white, native XYZ->RGB, native chroma basis
